what: Near-black plate with two layers of domain-warped noise fog drifting very slowly (.05 per second), and a warm torch glow (Gaussian width 2.4) at the cursor. The glow follows the cursor by min(1, dt×3) each frame and settles within 1 second once the cursor stops. The fog is pressed down with smoothstep(.35, 1) so most of it stays black, edges darken by 45%, and a little cool tint is mixed in far from the glow (WebGL)

options.follow: Speed the light follows at (times per second), default 3
options.--fx-fog-base · --fx-fog-gold · --fx-fog: Background, golden haze, cold air, torch color — default is a dark gold built from the skin variables
options.fx:theme: After swapping the Skin, fire at the element to re-read its color

note: On touch devices (hover false) the light rests above the panel center (.5, .45). The shader is drawn once on attach to precompile it
